article.headline: Mourinho benching Bellingham as Vinícius returns for Champions League against PSV
article.summary: Real Madrid coach Jose Mourinho makes six lineup changes for the Champions League clash against PSV, including resting Jude Bellingham.
article.body:
Real Madrid head coach Jose Mourinho is rotating his squad heavily for tonight’s Champions League match, as Jude Bellingham moves to the bench to accommodate six changes from the team's last appearance. The decision follows Mourinho’s prior warning regarding the heavy schedule, which sees the squad playing three matches within an eight-day window.

This shift in strategy highlights the internal squad management required as Madrid navigates a packed European and domestic calendar. With Vinícius Jr. returning to the starting eleven, the tactical setup shifts significantly, placing Arda Güler in the '10' role, with Diomande on the right and Vinícius operating on the left to support Kylian Mbappé.

The starting defensive line features Valverde and Cucurella as full-backs, with Militao and Rüdiger anchoring the center, while Bernardo and Tchouaméni form the double pivot. Courtois remains the confirmed starter in goal for the encounter at the Santiago Bernabéu.

Opponents PSV Eindhoven arrive with their own tactical adjustment, as coach Peter Bosz brings in 20-year-old Paul Wanner to replace Mauro Júnior, who faces a long-term injury layoff until the end of the year. While questions previously surrounded the fitness of Sergiño Dest following his recent international break, the defender confirmed his availability for tonight’s match.

article.headline: Mo, Moyin, and Tom Clash in All-Male Great British Bake Off Final
article.summary: The 17th series of The Great British Bake Off concludes on Tuesday night with three young finalists competing for the crown.
article.body: Law student Mo Mahir, political economy graduate Moyin Odeniran, and hairdresser Tom Whittaker are set to battle for the 17th Bake Off title. The grand final features an entirely male lineup, with each contestant aged 25 or under. Tom Whittaker enters the final as the bookies' favourite, having already secured the Star Baker title three times throughout the competition. The finalists have endured nine weeks of challenges in the tent to reach this concluding episode. The series has been marked by the arrival of new judge Nigella Lawson, who joined Paul Hollywood for this edition, sparking a resurgence in popularity. With viewing figures reaching 7.1 million for the series opener, the show has outperformed other major television programmes, cementing its status as a ratings success for Channel 4. Lawson’s presence has been widely credited with providing a fresh dynamic alongside the veteran judge, helping the franchise overcome previous signs of stagnation. Fans and critics have noted the contrast in styles between the judges, with Lawson’s articulate and passionate approach to tasting becoming a signature element of the season. The competition concludes on Tuesday night, when the winner will be crowned following the final set of challenges.

news.og_desc: بدأ العد التنازلي مبكرًا لموسم دراما رمضان 2027، وبدأت كواليس المنافسة تتحرك على أرض الواقع، بعدما أعلن المؤلف محمد سيد بشير انطلاق تصوير مسلسله الجديد «حرب باردة»، الذي يجمع كوكبة من النجوم في مقدمتهم غادة عادل وطارق لطفي وأحمد رزق، في عمل يراهن صناعه على جذب الأنظار مبكرًا، قبل أشهر من انطلاق السباق الرمضاني. وكشف محمد سيد بشير عن بدء التصوير من خلال مجموعة صور نشرها عبر حسابه الرسمي على موقع «إنستجرام»، وعلق عليها قائلًا: «من توكل على الله فهو حسبه ووكيله.. بداية تصوير مسلسل «حرب باردة»، إخراج أحمد جبة، وإنتاج أحمد الجنايني والمنتج رامي أحمد، وتأليفي.. رمضان 2027 بإذن الله». ويشهد المسلسل تغييرًا في اسمه، بعدما كان يحمل عنوان «نص نص الليل»، قبل الاستقرار على «حرب باردة»، وهو عنوان يفتح الباب أمام تساؤلات حول طبيعة الصراعات والأحداث التي سيقدمها العمل، خاصة مع اجتماع مجموعة من النجوم أصحاب التجارب المتنوعة في الدراما المصرية.
